# Dr Python Solutions — Full Technical & Architecture Specification

> **Organization:** Dr Python Solutions  
> **Domain:** https://drpythonsolutions.com  
> **Email:** contact@drpythonsolutions.com  
> **Location:** Dhaka, Bangladesh  
> **Primary Tech Stack:** Python (FastAPI, Django REST Framework, Playwright, Scrapy), Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx.

---

## 1. Overview & Business Summary

Dr Python Solutions is a boutique software engineering agency specializing in complex web automation, enterprise-scale web scraping, custom REST API design, and modern full-stack web applications. 

We solve high-friction technical challenges—such as bypassing sophisticated anti-bot systems, managing high-throughput asynchronous data streams, and delivering zero-lag client interfaces.

---

## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### A. Advanced Web Scraping & Ingestion Pipelines
- **Anti-Bot & WAF Evasion:** Expertise in navigating Cloudflare, Akamai, Datadome, PerimeterX, and Incapsula protections using browser fingerprint masking, TLS fingerprint matching, and dynamic header mutation.
- **Browser Automation:** Headless/Headful browser cluster management using Playwright, Selenium, and Puppeteer with residential and mobile proxy rotation.
- **Parsing & Data Structuring:** High-speed HTML/XML/JSON parsing utilizing BeautifulSoup4, Selectolax, lxml, and pydantic schema validation.
- **Resilience & Storage:** Asynchronous job execution (Celery, Redis), automatic retry loops with exponential backoff, and ingestion into PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or S3/minio targets.

### B. Scalable API & Backend Engineering
- **Frameworks:** Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Django, Django REST Framework), Node.js / Next.js server routes.
- **Architecture:** Asynchronous event loops, RESTful endpoint standards, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation generation, microservice orchestration.
- **Database & Caching:** PostgreSQL query optimization, Redis key-value caching, relational index tuning, and migration safety.
- **Security & Infrastructure:** JWT/OAuth2 authentication, CORS policy management, rate limiting, systemd service management, and Nginx reverse proxy configuration with HTTP/2 and Brotli compression.

### C. Full-Stack Web Development
- **Frontend Stack:** Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TypeScript, JavaScript.
- **Performance Standards:** Server-Side Rendering (SSR), React Server Components (RSC), code-splitting, critical-path CSS optimization, zero-layout-shift (CLS) UI engineering.

---

## 4. Standard Engineering Lifecycle

1. **Discovery & Feasibility:** Requirements analysis, target site anti-bot evaluation, schema mapping, and rate-limit profiling.
2. **Phase 1 Execution (Frontend / API Contracts):** Delivering early mock endpoints, database schemas, or frontend UI layout shells.
3. **Core Engine Construction:** Crawler/API logic implementation, proxy rotation integration, and error recovery setup.
4. **Resilience & Security Hardening:** Load testing, stress testing asynchronous worker pools, and memory leak checks.
5. **Deployment:** Docker containerization or systemd background service deployment on Ubuntu VPS with automated restart policies.
